description: RFP compliance matrix + response — Build an RFP compliance matrix from the requirements and your capabilities: each requirement marked MEETS, PARTIAL or GAP with a drafted response and evidence, plus win themes, risks and clarifying questions. Score, gap list and BID / BID_WITH_GAPS / NO_BID_RISK verdict computed offline; flags claims with numbers not in your capabilities. Optional: company. Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).

capabilities.description: e.g. We offer 24/7 phone and chat support, native Salesforce integration, and completed SOC 2 Type I in 2025.

requirements.description: e.g. Vendor must provide 24/7 support. Solution shall be SOC 2 Type II certified. Must integrate with Salesforce.

name: ai_rfp_response
